summary: How to update an Android Studio build from AAPS 3.2.0.x to 3.2.0.4: the required Android Studio, Gradle and JVM versions and computer specifications, then fetching the code, selecting JVM 17, checking out the 3.2.0.4 branch, syncing Gradle, building and installing. Labels such as Gradle Settings and Gradle JDK are Android Studio labels, not AAPS app strings.
